root_cause_analysis: Meta API returned OAuthException Code 4 / Subcode 2207051 ('Application request limit reached / Action is blocked'). The account or application has triggered Meta's rate limiting or community protection filters, causing an action block.
actionable_instructions: Check Meta Business Suite and Meta Developer Dashboard for account status warnings or policy violations.
Pause automated publishing attempts for 24 to 48 hours to allow the non-transient action block to expire.
Review API call volume and posting frequency to ensure compliance with Meta Graph API rate limits.
